scope: Standalone public /listener/:slug. Read-along, narration-linked highlighting and text-linked audio navigation are permanently retired across supported customer paths, including the legacy Reader. Duration, chapter/segment navigation, manual Reader selection/annotations and accounting remain.
source_findings: Listener has no read-along capability or callback; caller flags cannot restore the retired control.
Listener uses native media time, exact package segment durations and chapter offsets; no cue fetching or text highlighting.
Shared manifest requires sidecar identities structurally; no schema/storage requirement is waived.
Legacy Reader no longer loads text cues, selects audio by word position, wraps/follows words or seeks audio from text. Ordinary Reader navigation and manual annotations remain independent.
